caption: The drawing depicts a tall, wooden secretary desk with a rich brown finish. The upper section features a double-door cabinet with arched panel designs and a prominent broken arch pediment at the top, including a central circular cut-out. Below the cabinet, there is a slanted writing surface that appears hinged, designed to fold down. When open, this exposes an interior compartmentalized with small drawers and vertical pigeonholes, with a central panel that is inscribed with "IJK 1766 FR" in small letters. The lower section consists of three wide drawers, each equipped with two ornate metal handles. The entire piece rests on bracket feet, and the wood grain detail is carefully rendered throughout the drawing. The background is a plain, off-white color, focusing attention entirely on the wooden secretary desk.
title: Desk
